description: This file defines a PHP class 'Smarty_Resource_Extendsall' that extends an internal Smarty resource class to handle template inheritance across directories. It implements methods to populate source metadata and disables timestamp checks, facilitating inheritance behavior in Smarty templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Resource_Extendsall
classes.description: A custom Smarty resource class that extends all templates by iterating over multiple template directories, inheriting templates with the same name across directories.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the source object with metadata by collecting template sources from multiple directories and inheriting templates accordingly.

methods.name: checkTimestamps
methods.description: Overrides to disable timestamp checks for the extended resource, relying on individual source components for validation.
